chapter: Small's Paradise, Fletcher Henderson and Horace
title: The Elite Serenaders and Roy Eldridge arrive at Small's
summary: The Elite Serenaders from Pittsburgh, with Roy Eldridge and his brother, came to Small's in 1926 while Charlie Johnson was in Atlantic City.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it

blocks.x: I mean -- see, when did Roy come to Elmer Snowden -- Roy Eldridge? Did he come -- yeah, he did come around (unintelligible), didn't he?

He came here -- I'll tell you how the band -- he came here in 1926 with the Elite Serenaders, a band that came out of Pittsburgh. They came -- I was downstairs with Willie Gant at the time they came here in Small's. Charles was in Atlantic City, but his original band -- and they came there from Pittsburgh, the Elite Serenaders. It was -- Greely Walton (unintelligible) came in with that band.

And Roy and his brother was in the band. Actually, the band was really -- Fletcher and his little brother brought a band here from out of Columbus, Ohio, because all went to school at Wilberforce University, some of them did. And he brought a band here -- of course, Rex came back with the band.
